facts.value: Take the Yellow Jacket Tower trail, leave it just below Yellow Jacket, rising traverse into Hook Creek, cross creek to upper basin

About 5 hours to the upper basin below the Hook Creek/Rat Creek group.
Climbed in two pitches: a long 5.7 crack pitch then a 60+ m easier pitch to the summit.

facts.value: Moss-filled diagonal cracks; take the left branch where the cracks split (right branch is mossy fist cracks)

evidence.fact: Where the cracks split, the right option was moss-choked; the left had cleaner 5.7 cracks.
Three single-rope rappels into the gully on the southeast side.

evidence.fact: After raps into the SE gully they plunge-stepped and glissaded back to camp.
